TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: This lookup returns UDC columns Key, Code, Desc1and Desc2 from User defined tables. If you have column UDC value "01/03" then Pass "01" to UDC_TYPE_CODE1 and "02" to UDC_TYPE_CODE2
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_UDC_DIM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_KEY AS UDC_KEY, USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_CODE AS UDC_CODE , USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_DESC1 AS UDC_DESC1, USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_DESC2 AS UDC_DESC2, USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_PRODUCT_CODE AS UDC_PRODUCT_CODE, USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_CODES AS UDC_CODES FROM USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM , USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE WHERE USER_DEFINED_CODE_DIM.UDC_TYPE_KEY=USER_DEFINED_CODE_TYPE.UDC_TYPE_KEY

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup condition
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: UDC_CODE = i_UDC_CODE AND UDC_PRODUCT_CODE = i_UDC_TYPE_CODE1 AND UDC_CODES = i_UDC_TYPE_CODE2

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION:
Get User Defined Code's KEY, DESC1 and DESC2 for JDE UDC_TYPE CODES.
Usage: ======= 1. If you column have UDC "01/02" then pass "01" to UDC_TYPE CODE1 and "02" to UDC_TYPE CODE2. Please make sure you are passing Value before "/" to UDC_TYPE CODE1. 2. Pass Code column value to UDC_CODE
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_GET_UDC_CODE

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT TRIM(COLITM) AS PART_NUMBER , MAX(COUNCS)/10000 AS UNIT_STD_COST FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F4105, $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0006, $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F0010 WHERE COLEDG = '07' AND TRIM(COMCU) = TRIM(MCMCU) AND CCCO = MCCO AND CCCRCD = 'USD' GROUP BY COLITM

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT TRIM(IMLITM) AS PART_NUMBER , BPUPRC/10000 AS UNIT_STD_PRICE FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F4106 bp , $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F40942 ck , $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F4101 im WHERE BPCRCD = 'USD' AND BP.BPCGID = CK.CKCGID AND BPITM = IMITM AND JDE.TO_JULIAN(SYSDATE) BETWEEN BPEFTJ AND BPEXDJ -- and ck.ckcpgp IN (' ','EX08USB ','SALKITS ','RE00010 ') AND CK.CKCPGP IN ('SALKITS ')

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT TRIM(IM.IMLITM) AS PART_NUMBER ,UM."UMCONV"/10000000 AS UOM_CONERSION_FACTOR FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema."F4101" IM INNER JOIN $$ParamJDEDATASchema."F41002" UM ON IM."IMITM" = UM."UMITM" AND RTRIM(IM."IMUOM1") = RTRIM(UM."UMUM") WHERE ( (UM."UMRUM" = 'EA' AND IM.IMGLPT = 'CH30' ) OR (UM."UMRUM" = 'RX' AND IM.IMGLPT IN (SELECT TRIM(DRKY) FROM $$ParamJDECTLSchema.F0005 WHERE DRSY = '41' AND DRRT = '9' AND TRIM(DRDL02) = 'Reagents') ) )

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Lookup Sql Override
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT T1$$RVRP as SEGMENTS, T1ITM as PART_NUMBER, T1$$CLNM AS EBS_CLONE_NAME, T1$$PSKU AS EBS_PRE_SKU, T1$$PRLT AS PRODUCT_LAUNCH_TYPE, T1$$SRCE AS EBS_SOURCE, T1$$RTLD AS ROOT_LAUNCH_DATE, T1$$PRDT AS PRODUCT_RELEASE_DATE , T1$$PRCT AS ITEM_CATEGORY, T1$$PABC AS PLANNING_ABC FROM $$ParamJDEDATASchema.F554101T
